task_definition.task_description: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, look up AAPL’s current stock information, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, and assess the risk for a $1,500 trade. Then, if that’s cleared, place a limit order for AAPL at 170.25, after that get the current NASDAQ market window and archive it as a post-trade market record for trader_42 in the app with medium priority, and finally check the status of my living room AC and turn it on.

Finally, check the status of my living room AC with device ID ac_living and turn it on so the desired power state is on.
